thread:
maya: Quick postmortem action tracker for AcmeRetail outage — VPC peering flap + on‑prem router config caused partial isolation. Summarizing items from bridge call.

leo: thanks. can you paste the list of owners/tl;dr?

maya: TL;DR: 1) Fix peering teardown race (root cause) 2) Harden onprem install + docs 3) Add network egress isolation checks 4) Create recurring monitor for peering flaps 5) Customer communication & follow-up

sarah: I'll take #2 (onprem install + docs). ETA Wed EOD 2026-04-01. I'll add the install checklist to the repo and ping SEs.

raj: Taking #1 (peering teardown race). I already have a repro from the logs. Plan: patch runtime to wait for BGP flaps + add backoff. Target PR by Tue.

leo: I'll own #3 (egress isolation checks). Proposal: deploy iptables egress default-deny for dedicated nodes and add unit tests in infra-e2e. ETA Fri.

oliver: I'll set up the recurring monitor for peering flaps (#4). Will add a daily probe and slack alert to #eng-network. Doing it today.

maya: Customer comms: I'll draft a short note explaining root cause and actions, include mitigations. Want to share with legal before sending. Due Thu.

raj: Note on repro: logs show peering closure at 10:12:03 then rapid reconnects; kv-cache eviction caused node to accept traffic from legacy route for ~90s. Putting a protective guard in place.

sarah: Docs checklist (short): hardware prep, network ACLs, onprem agent service account, offline install steps, rollback steps. Will add checklist + commands.

leo: Quick blocker: for default-deny we need to ensure metrics export still works. I'll open a PR that exempts statsd endpoints.

oncall-bot: Deploy pipeline finished: dedicated-runtime v1.3.7 deployed to staging (build 8942)

maya: Action item tracker updated in Notion: https://redwood.company/notion/acme-retro — please add your PR links. We'll reconvene Mon 10:00 to validate production patch.

oliver: added probe, created alert rule: peering-flap-rate > 3 in 5m -> page eng-network.

leo: filing follow-up: add integration test for peering teardown in CI. assigning to infra team.

maya: Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker ping me. :thumbsup:
